description: Sent to a student when they join the waiting list for a title that is currently all on loan, confirming their position in the queue. Triggered by placing a reservation that goes onto the waitlist.
subject: Reservation placed: {{book_title}}
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We've placed your reservation:

  Item:     {{book_title}}
  Position: {{queue_position}} in the queue

We'll email you as soon as a copy is ready to collect. Reservations are filled in the order they were placed.

{{system_name}} Library
